THE COMPLETE DOCTOR ACADEMYMRCPsych Paper B · Domain 13 Research Methods, Statistics, Critical Review and Evidence-Based Practice

Aim and objectives

Aim. To prepare you to interpret survival analyses and common research graphs for MRCPsych Paper B.

At the end of this chapter, you should be able to:

  1. Explain censoring and interpret a Kaplan-Meier curve, reading median survival where the curve crosses 50%.
  2. Compare the log-rank test with Cox regression and state the proportional hazards assumption.
  3. Interpret forest plots and L'Abbé plots, identifying the pooled estimate and the line of no effect.
  4. Interpret a ROC curve and its area under the curve, where 0.5 indicates no discrimination.
  5. Explain the ecological fallacy and use a CONSORT flow diagram to trace every randomised participant.
  6. Calculate an ICER and interpret QALYs, the cost-effectiveness plane and the acceptability curve.
  7. Answer the chapter's 36 exam-style questions, scoring at least 80%, by the end of this chapter.
